snippet.title: Splody Gameplay | PS4
snippet.description:
Gameplay for Splody on PlayStation 4.

If you grew up playing video games in the '90s then you've probably played your fair share of Bomberman games. Splody is yet another Bomberman clone but does it add anything exciting to the established formula? Full review - https://videochums.com/article/family-friendly-console-games#splody
